audit_meta.target_framework: CII RT-153 (Craft Labor Density Mix vs. Total Project Rework Percentage)

data_governance_rules.name: Row-Completeness Filter
data_governance_rules.action: Dropped rows with total non-null craft sums strictly under 90% to eliminate catastrophic data blind spots.
data_governance_rules.justification: Prevents severe reporting failures from skewing the underlying baseline data profile.

data_governance_rules.name: Pure 100% Pool Zero-Fill
data_governance_rules.action: Converted remaining np.NaN entries to 0% strictly within projects where recorded fields summed to ~100%.
data_governance_rules.justification: Captures true structural zeros (crafts intentionally omitted from a project), allowing the Pearson algorithm to correctly process zero-allocation, high-performance project context.

data_governance_rules.name: Partial Pool Pairwise Preservation
data_governance_rules.action: Preserved np.NaN values in rows with minor rounding gaps, letting the system natively apply pairwise deletion during calculation.
data_governance_rules.justification: Maximizes the use of verified project metrics while cleanly preventing forced data skew in unverified fields.

primary_risk_drivers: Piping concentration remains the highest systemic risk driver for rework (+0.059096).
Equipment, Structural, and Electrical crafts all correctly flip to positive risk multipliers once structural zeros are properly mapped.
quality_anchors: Civil and 'Other' crafts are verified as the primary stabilizers, maintaining an inverse relationship with rework rates across all 37 validated projects.
